//: Config for the edge functions, and it exists to solve one specific
problem: the repo root holds the Expo app's package.json, and Deno takes
the presence of a package.json to mean npm dependencies are resolved from
node_modules. The edge-function CI job never runs npm install -- it has no
reason to, it is checking Deno code -- so node_modules is absent and the
check fails on a transitive npm dependency of supabase-js.
nodeModulesDir 'none' tells Deno to resolve npm packages from its own
global cache instead. The edge functions have no node_modules of their
own and should not grow one: they are deployed by the Supabase CLI, which
Reproduced before fixing: supabase/ + deno.lock alone passes; adding the
root package.json with no node_modules reproduces the CI failure exactly.
